description: x402 endpoint doctor: probes a paid x402 URL unpaid (GET, HEAD, empty POST, CORS; never pays) and grades it A-F: 402 behavior, v2 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header and v1 body, accepts (USDC asset, EIP-712 domain, Solana feePayer, amounts, payTo), multichain consistency and the Bazaar declaration. Use it after deploying or changing a paid route. Free preview by default (grade, score, status, counts). With X402FIX_X402_PRIVATE_KEY set, returns the paid check report (numbered fix list, CDP facilitator validate verdict, payee checks, generated extensions.bazaar block and multichain accepts) from https://api.youraitools.co/x402fix/v1/check, paying $0.02 USDC on Base per check over x402. Automated, unpaid probe of a public x402 endpoint: no payment is made. Fixes are suggestions; a passing grade does not guarantee listing or settlement.

method.description: Method the route uses (default: from its Bazaar declaration)

url.description: Full https URL of the paid x402 route
